mechanism: Tobramycin may potentiate dopaminergic effects of ropinirole and increase neurotoxicity risk through additive CNS effects; tobramycin can also cause ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity which may complicate ropinirole therapy in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor renal function closely, assess for signs of ototoxicity and enhanced dopaminergic side effects; consider alternative antibiotics if possible, particularly in elderly patients or those with baseline renal impairment.
